verifications.claim: Dunkin' is giving away 1 million free coffees to Dunkin' Rewards members on April 21, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "The coffee chain is giving away another million coffees on Tuesday, April 21" (R2); "Dunkin' Donuts is giving away 1 million free coffees [...] April 21st" (R3); "Dunkin' is giving away one million free coffees on April 21" (R4)
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly confirm 1 million free coffees for Rewards members on April 21, 2026.

verifications.claim: The Dunkin' free coffees giveaway starts at 9 a.m. local time on April 21, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "beginning 9 a.m. local time on April 21" (R2); "The drop begins at 9 a.m. local time Tuesday" (R3); "starting at 9 a.m. local time on April 21" (R4)
verifications.reasoning: All relevant sources explicitly state the start time and date.

verifications.claim: Users must enter the promo code "FREECOFFEE1" in the Dunkin' mobile app to claim a free medium hot or iced coffee.
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: "use promo code "FREECOFFEE1" in their Dunkin' app" (R2); "use the code "freecoffee1" to redeem the offer" (R3); "using the promo code “FREECOFFEE1”" (R4) for free coffee
verifications.reasoning: Sources confirm promo code and app for free coffee, but do not specify 'medium' size.

verifications.claim: The free coffee certificate is valid for seven days after entry.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "seven days after getting the offer to redeem it" (R2); "valid for seven days after the promo code entry" (R3, R4)

verifications.claim: Dunkin' Rewards membership is free to join.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "join Dunkin’ Rewards for free through the Dunkin’ app" (R1); "Join DD Perks® today [...] Not a Dunkin’ Rewards member? Learn More" (R5); "Join millions of members [...] Get the Dunkin’ App and sign in as a member" (R6)
verifications.reasoning: Explicitly free to join in R1; supported by app and rewards pages.

verifications.claim: Cold Brew and Extra-Large Hot Coffees are not included in the promotion.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Cold brew and extra-large hot coffees are not included" (R2); "Cold Brew and Extra-Large Hot Coffees are not included" (R3); "does not include Cold Brew or Extra-Large Hot Coffee" (R4)

verifications.claim: The promotion limit is one per customer while supplies last.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "limit of one per customer [...] while supplies last" (R2); "limited to one per customer while supplies last" (R3, R4)
verifications.reasoning: Precisely confirmed in all relevant sources.

verifications.claim: USA Today reported a similar promotion in April 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: USA Today article dated April 20, 2026: "Dunkin' is giving away 1 million free coffees again [...] on Tuesday, April 21"
verifications.reasoning: R2 is a USA Today report on the exact promotion in April 2026.
